name: @operon/alchemy
description: Operon cell infrastructure: PostgreSQL 17 in Docker, provisioned by Alchemy

scripts.plan: umask 077 && mkdir -p .alchemy && chmod 700 .alchemy && STAGE="${STAGE:-local}" node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/alchemy.js plan --env-file ../../.env
scripts.up: pnpm run env && umask 077 && mkdir -p .alchemy && chmod 700 .alchemy && STAGE="${STAGE:-local}" node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/alchemy.js deploy --env-file ../../.env --yes
scripts.down: umask 077 && mkdir -p .alchemy && chmod 700 .alchemy && STAGE="${STAGE:-local}" node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/alchemy.js destroy --env-file ../../.env --yes
